description: Use this when a student pastes an essay or summary for a PTE, IELTS, TOEFL, LanguageCert, MET or CELPIP writing task and wants a score. Returns marks out of the exam task maximum, a score and one line of feedback for each marking criterion, and the top improvements. Pass the questionId from practice_question when the text answers one of our questions; otherwise pass the prompt the student wrote to. Pass exactly one of the two. Free up to a daily limit. This is the quick score: Personalised Tips on the site add sentence-level annotations and verified marks. When the student is signed in to ScoreFluent and the text answers one of our questions, the scored attempt is saved to their History.

prompt.description: The prompt the student wrote to, when the text does not answer one of our questions.

questionId.description: The questionId returned by practice_question, when the text answers one of our questions.

taskType.description: Writing task-type slug, e.g. "write-essay" or "summarize-written-text". Call exam_overview to list the valid slugs.

text.description: The student's essay or summary, exactly as they wrote it.
